<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindAJob" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ApplicationReceiptConfirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ApplicationRating" name="Application rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PotentialJobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ProbationOffer" name="Probation offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyRatingOfApplicant" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ApplicantRatingOfCompany" name="Applicant rating of company"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobMadePermanent" name="Job made permanent"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" name="Send job application" sourceRef="A_Send" targetRef="C_Start" messageRef="Msg_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Confirm receipt" sourceRef="C_Confirm" targetRef="A_CatchConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationReceiptConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AppRating" name="Rate application" sourceRef="C_SendAppRating" targetRef="A_CatchAppRating" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ProbationOffer" name="Offer probation" sourceRef="C_SendProbation" targetRef="A_CatchProbation" messageRef="Msg_ProbationOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyRatingOfApplicant" name="Rate applicant" sourceRef="C_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="A_CatchCompanyRating" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRatingOfApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ApplicantRatingOfCompany" name="Rate company" sourceRef="A_SendCompanyRating" targetRef="C_CatchApplicantRating" messageRef="Msg_ApplicantRatingOfCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Permanent" name="Job made permanent" sourceRef="C_SendPermanent" targetRef="A_CatchPermanent" messageRef="Msg_JobMadePermanent"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Job applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="A_Start" name="Job search started"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_MergeReporting" name="Reporting cycle"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="A_Send" name="Send job application"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchConfirmation" name="Receipt confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchConfirmation_ED" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationReceiptConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchAppRating" name="Application rating received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchAppRating_ED" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="A_Report" name="Report job applications to companies"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="A_EventGateway" name="Next event"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchOffer" name="Potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchOffer_ED" messageRef="Msg_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchProbation" name="Probation offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchProbation_ED" messageRef="Msg_ProbationOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="A_CompleteProbation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="A_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="A_SendCompanyRating" name="Send company rating"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchCompanyRating" name="Company rating of you received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchCompanyRating_ED" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRatingOfApplicant"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchPermanent" name="Job made permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchPermanent_ED" messageRef="Msg_JobMadePermanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_RatingDecision" name="Company rated C or less?" default="Flow_A_EndDefault"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_MergeOffers" name="Continue receiving offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchOfferContinuing" name="Potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchOfferContinuing_ED" messageRef="Msg_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="A_End" name="Job search ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="A_Start" targetRef="A_MergeReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="A_MergeReporting" targetRef="A_Send"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="A_Send" targetRef="A_CatchConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="A_CatchConfirmation" targetRef="A_CatchAppRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="A_CatchAppRating" targetRef="A_Report"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="A_Report" targetRef="A_EventGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="A_EventGateway" targetRef="A_CatchOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="A_EventGateway" targetRef="A_CatchProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="A_CatchOffer" targetRef="A_MergeReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="A_CatchProbation" targetRef="A_CompleteProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="A_CompleteProbation" targetRef="A_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="A_RateCompany" targetRef="A_SendCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="A_SendCompanyRating" targetRef="A_CatchCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="A_CatchCompanyRating" targetRef="A_CatchPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="A_CatchPermanent" targetRef="A_RatingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" name="C or less" sourceRef="A_RatingDecision" targetRef="A_MergeOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyRatingCOrLess}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_EndDefault" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="A_RatingDecision" targetRef="A_End"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="A_MergeOffers" targetRef="A_CatchOfferContinuing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" sourceRef="A_CatchOfferContinuing" targetRef="A_MergeOffers"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C_Start" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="C_Start_ED" messageRef="Msg_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_Confirm" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_SendAppRating" name="Send application rating"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_InterviewSplit" name="Interview negotiated?" default="Flow_C_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_InterviewJoin" name="Interview decision merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_HireSplit" name="Company wants you to work for them?" default="Flow_C_NoHire"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_SendProbation" name="Send probation offer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_ProbationPhase" name="Conduct probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_SendApplicantRating" name="Send rating of applicant"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_CatchApplicantRating" name="Applicant rating of company received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="C_CatchApplicantRating_ED" messageRef="Msg_ApplicantRatingOfCompany"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="C_ParallelSplit" name="Split after rating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_SendPermanent" name="Confirm job made permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C_EndPermanent" name="Job made permanent"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_TimerOneYear" name="Wait one year">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="C_TimerOneYear_ED">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="C_MakeReviewsVisible" name="Make company reviews visible to applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C_EndReviewsVisible" name="Reviews released"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C_NoHireEnd" name="Application not pursued"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="C_Start" targetRef="C_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="C_Confirm" targetRef="C_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="C_RateApplication" targetRef="C_SendAppRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="C_SendAppRating" targetRef="C_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="C_InterviewSplit" targetRef="C_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewNegotiated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NoInterview" name="No interview" sourceRef="C_InterviewSplit" targetRef="C_InterviewJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="C_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="C_InterviewJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="C_InterviewJoin" targetRef="C_HireSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" name="Hire" sourceRef="C_HireSplit" targetRef="C_SendProbation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyWantsToHire}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NoHire" name="No hire" sourceRef="C_HireSplit" targetRef="C_NoHireEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="C_SendProbation" targetRef="C_ProbationPhase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="C_ProbationPhase" targetRef="C_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="C_RateApplicant" targetRef="C_SendApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="C_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="C_CatchApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="C_CatchApplicantRating" targetRef="C_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="C_ParallelSplit" targetRef="C_SendPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="C_SendPermanent" targetRef="C_EndPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="C_ParallelSplit" targetRef="C_TimerOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="C_TimerOneYear" targetRef="C_MakeReviewsVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="C_MakeReviewsVisible" targetRef="C_EndReviewsVisible"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
